statusText: EA_ON / green: latest verified reporting shows modestly firmer Nasdaq futures and easing crude, while elevated front-end yields and Gulf risk keep Stress extreme; no granular NQ sequence verifies persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; the U.S. cash-open transition is the main conditional price-path checkpoint.
headline: Modest futures gains keep Tail low while yields and Gulf risk sustain extreme Stress
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq futures about 0.4% higher, S&P futures up 0.3%, the U.S. 2-year yield near 4.76%, and WTI near $100. U.S.-China talks produced incremental proposals but left material issues unresolved. Shared Finviz context is stale and partial. No verified granular NQ sequence shows repeated extension or failed retracements.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC hours, Tail was mostly 15-19% / green, rose to WATCH at 22:00-23:00 UTC around Sunday reopening, and returned to 19% then 18% / green at 00:00-01:00 UTC as available evidence remained orderly.
outlookSummary: Tail is low in the current hour because available evidence does not show persistent one-way NQ structure. The primary conditional WATCH window is 12:00-15:00 UTC around the U.S. cash-open transition, with a smaller conditional WATCH checkpoint at 19:00 UTC for power hour.
